BREAKING: in July 2026, *every single one* of the 2,528 refugees admitted in the U.S. were white South Africans.

In FY 2026, the U.S. has admitted a total of 10,255 white South Africans, three Afghans (back in November), and nobody else. 

For reference, the U.S. admitted 100,060 refugees in 2024.
